global: pizzicato strings, bouncy bass, glockenspiel, kazoo-like woodwinds, brass stabs, light drums

sections.name: hook
sections.style: cheerful delivery fanfare that suddenly wobbles and falls apart, comic brass crash and a sliding trombone 'uh-oh'

sections.name: order

sections.name: wobble

sections.name: lightsout

sections.name: giftcard

sections.name: ending
sections.style: warm playful outro, bouncy pizzicato and glockenspiel melody, cheeky button ending
